entry.title: An Introduction to 24/7 Insight Contemplation Into The Nature Of Reality; Are you Already Doing This Ancient Lost Secret Technique?
entry.summary: The Buddha, the Chan masters and the Dzogchen lineage all teach a contemplation that never stops, in walking, eating, speaking and sleep. What it is, where the canon says it, and why you may already be doing it.

entry.title: Agent harness vs scaffolding
entry.summary: Agent harness vs scaffolding, with a distinction you can build with. The scaffold is the fixed ground an agent is anchored to, and the harness is what the loop grows from its own failures.

entry.title: AI agent vs subagent
entry.summary: AI agent vs subagent. A subagent is a new bounded agent created when one context reaches its limit, and multi-agent systems succeed or fail at the seams between those boundaries.

entry.title: Are AI agents just prompts?
entry.summary: Are AI agents just prompts, just markdown files, just wrappers, or just LLMs? The prompt is one of the cuts that produces an agent, and the agent is what all the cuts produce together.

entry.title: Do AI agents die when the session ends?
entry.summary: Do AI agents die, persist or expire when a session ends? The pattern in the context ends, what was written down continues, and that an agent can end is part of what makes it an agent.

entry.title: Do AI agents have agency?
entry.summary: Do AI agents have agency? The question assumes agency is a possession. Treated as something enacted, agency can be located in an AI agent, and three conditions show how much of it is the agent's own.

entry.title: Do AI agents have memory?
entry.summary: Do AI agents have memory? A language model keeps nothing between calls, and an agent remembers through its context, memory files and records. Editing that memory changes the agent itself.

entry.title: What is agentiality?
entry.summary: Agentiality is the friction through which distinct agents come to exist. A definition of agentiality, how it differs from agency, and what it means for AI agents.

entry.title: What is an AI agent? A definition you can build with
entry.summary: An AI agent is a pattern of cause and effect that has accumulated enough friction to be addressed as one being. The definition in simple terms, with every agent question answered in its own post.

entry.title: Flower of Life Generator

entry.title: The Bodhisattva Coder
entry.summary: A command for Claude Code that begins every coding session with vows to benefit all beings — the prompt shared, and what it does.

entry.title: Translating an ancient Tibetan text into English with AI
entry.summary: Working with AI to carry an ancient Tibetan text into English — the process, what the AI brings, and what only a human reader can hold.

entry.title: What is a prompt language?
entry.summary: A prompt language is a way of writing to AI where the structure itself carries meaning — what a prompt language is, why one exists, and what it changes.

entry.title: What is (: Smile?
entry.summary: Smile is a prompt language built from nested emoticons — the faces are the delimiters, and their features are the syntax.
